hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 2000 ms, augmenting the round-2 supported destroy score with a normalized Shaw spatial-relatedness term and a deterministic index-hash jitter, with the stagnation-driven rank power re-pointed at modulating the savings-vs-relatedness blend (diversified mid-tail removal under stagnation) will lower mean objective below the round-2 record 16.078067, with the largest per-instance gains on the reported weakest regimes (spatial=clustered, depot_style=eccentric, size=100, capacity_level=loose), because the round-2 gains came from gate concentration and now saturate (round-2 vs round-1 delta only -0.0516, archive gap_over_sbs 0.19%), so the remaining headroom is in removal-set diversity rather than in severity of savings ranking.

next_search_advice.direction: Densify the destroy score into a two-component mixed operator: keep the round-2 multiplicative gates (removal savings / depot-distance / route-load saturation) but add a Shaw-style spatial-relatedness term (customer's mean distance to the k nearest other customers, normalized — high for isolated customers, low inside tight clusters) plus a deterministic index-hash jitter, so that on clustered/loose-capacity instances removal alternates between isolated outliers and cluster interiors instead of repeatedly picking the same high-savings ring, with the stagnation-driven rank exponent now modulating the savings-vs-relatedness mix ratio rather than only the tail rank.
